title: Create Motion Path (ArrangeAndOrganize)

scenarios.title: Create Motion Path applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Create Motion Path (BtnCreateMotionPath) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Motion-path delta and mode expansion are pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: Create Motion Path expands its mode host-free (FirstToSecond animates only forward, SecondToFirst only backward, BothDirections both), measures the center-to-center delta of the two shapes as a fraction of the slide size, and builds the motion path string with invariant-culture coordinates regardless of the user's locale.

scenarios.title: Create Motion Path writes the forward slide-relative motion path in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Create Motion Path (first shape to second shape) adds exactly one timeline effect whose motion path carries the center-to-center delta of the two probes as a fraction of the slide size (measured fixture: 0.3333;0.4074), the feature reports execution, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.

scenarios.title: Create Motion Path writes the backward slide-relative motion path in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Create Motion Path (second shape to first shape, the right-click reverse route) adds exactly one timeline effect whose motion path carries the negated center-to-center delta (measured fixture: -0.3333;-0.4074), the feature reports execution, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.

scenarios.title: Create Motion Path writes both directions in one undo entry in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Create Motion Path (both directions) adds exactly two timeline effects, one carrying the forward delta (0.3333;0.4074) and one the negated delta (-0.3333;-0.4074), the feature reports execution, no new entry appears in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and the host stays stable.
